assertions.description: decodingInfo() resolves with a boolean supported field for an unencrypted H.264 query.
assertions.test: navigator.mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo({ type: 'media-source', video: { contentType: 'video/mp4; codecs="avc1.64001F"', width: 1280, height: 720, bitrate: 2500000, framerate: 30 } }).then((i) => typeof i.supported === 'boolean')

assertions.description: decodingInfo() accepts a keySystemConfiguration dictionary (Clear Key) and resolves with a boolean answer; only a NotSupportedError rejection (key system genuinely unavailable on the device) is acceptable, any other rejection fails.
assertions.test: navigator.mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo({ type: 'media-source', video: { contentType: 'video/mp4; codecs="avc1.64001F"', width: 1280, height: 720, bitrate: 2500000, framerate: 30 }, keySystemConfiguration: { keySystem: 'org.w3.clearkey', video: {} } }).then((i) => typeof i.supported === 'boolean', (e) => e && e.name === 'NotSupportedError')

assertions.description: The core v152 contract: with encryptionScheme set to an unrecognized value, an implementing browser must answer supported: false for a configuration it can otherwise decode (a browser that ignores the member answers true and fails; a device with no decodable baseline codec reports failure as indeterminate).
assertions.test: (async () => { const vids = [{ contentType: 'video/mp4; codecs="avc1.64001F"', width: 1280, height: 720, bitrate: 2500000, framerate: 30 }, { contentType: 'video/webm; codecs="vp09.00.10.08"', width: 1280, height: 720, bitrate: 2500000, framerate: 30 }, { contentType: 'video/mp4; codecs="av01.0.04M.08"', width: 1280, height: 720, bitrate: 2500000, framerate: 30 }]; for (const video of vids) { try { const base = await navigator.mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo({ type: 'media-source', video, keySystemConfiguration: { keySystem: 'org.w3.clearkey', video: {} } }); if (!base.supported) continue; const bogus = await navigator.mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo({ type: 'media-source', video, keySystemConfiguration: { keySystem: 'org.w3.clearkey', video: { encryptionScheme: 'showcase-nonexistent-scheme' } } }); return bogus.supported === false; } catch { continue; } } return false; })()

assertions.description: A 'cenc' encryptionScheme query resolves to a boolean answer (true or false are both valid device capabilities; rejection is only acceptable when the key system itself is unavailable).
assertions.test: navigator.mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo({ type: 'media-source', video: { contentType: 'video/mp4; codecs="avc1.64001F"', width: 1280, height: 720, bitrate: 2500000, framerate: 30 }, keySystemConfiguration: { keySystem: 'org.w3.clearkey', video: { encryptionScheme: 'cenc' } } }).then((i) => typeof i.supported === 'boolean', (e) => e.name === 'NotSupportedError')
